## Welcome

Mateenah is a PhD student in Community Psychology interested in in how identity, culture, critical consciousness, and community shape psychological development and sociopolitical engagement with a particular interest in queer and disabled youth of color

[Explore my research →](research.qmd)

## Beyond Research

My work in psychology is closely connected to a longstanding involvement in **theatre, dance, poetry, and community-based work**. I am interested in the ways creative and community spaces can shape how people understand themselves, connect with others, and navigate the worlds around them.

[Learn more about me →](about.qmd)
